The MoaA-only combined GTP-to-cPMP reaction is resolved as separate current MoaA and MoaC reactions in the exact native PWY-6823 route.
The same thiocarboxy carrier is mapped on both sides with inconsistent counts; current Rhea26334 instead consumes two thiocarboxy carriers and regenerates two carboxy carriers.
The real downstream MCD modification remains a separate follow-up. It is not treated as obsolete or covered by this record.
Inactive demerged identifier. The exact K-12 MoaC is P0A738; O157 and Shigella successors are excluded.
Thermus thermophilus assembly excluded; exact E. coli MoaC hexamer CPLX-8331 selected.
Pleiotropic and condition-dependent Moco role, without a chemically resolved direct MoaD net reaction. The exact native eight-reaction boundary is retained, not all sulfur-allocation regulation.
Assay conditions do not establish free-magnesium cofactor edges. MoeA magnesium rests on explicit structural annotation.
Two Fe-S clusters and cyclase function are inferred by HAMAP for K-12. Staphylococcus primary enzymes and anaerobic enzyme handling are not labelled direct K-12 evidence.
In vitro enhancement is retained as an enabling role, without isolated-catalyst sufficiency, obligatory in vivo function or a uniform compartment assertion.
